description: This Java class 'Lines' provides a utility for reading, storing, and iterating over lines of a file. It supports reading entire files into memory, navigating through lines, cloning sub-regions for parsing purposes, and rewinding the read position.

classes.name: Lines
classes.description: A generic class for parsing and iterating over lines of a text file, with support for sub-region cloning and rewind operations.

methods.name: readLines
methods.description: Reads all lines from a given File and returns a Lines object containing Line instances.

methods.name: readLines
methods.description: Reads all lines from a BufferedReader and returns a Lines object containing Line instances.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if there are more lines to read within the current range.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next Line object and advances the reading position; returns null if at the end.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Moves the read position back by one line.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Sets the read position to a specified index.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the total number of lines in the current range.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a new Lines object restricted to a specified sub-range of lines.
